profiles.description: Recruiter.com Group, Inc. operates a global on-demand recruitment platform, serving both the United States and international markets. The company specializes in providing expert consulting and staffing solutions to employers, which includes placing professional recruiters and sourcing other personnel. Additionally, it offers employers referrals to qualified candidates and grants subscription access to its proprietary web-based platforms for talent acquisition. Beyond direct recruitment, Recruiter.com Group assists businesses with a range of digital promotional services, such as sponsoring digital newsletters, boosting online content, distributing information via social media, banner advertising, and other branded electronic communications. For individuals, the company aids career advancement by distributing resumes and profiles to potential employers and provides upskilling and training programs. Its corporate headquarters are located in Bristol, Connecticut.
